name: AES Hardware Trojan Benchmark
description: Provides a set of improved AES-based hardware trojan instances and testcases to validate Trojan detection schemes in an ASIC design flow.
evaluation_method: accuracy (detection rate) with secondary use of TPR/FPR or AUC in some studies
reputation: A niche but recognized dataset in the hardware-security community for evaluating AES-based Trojan detection methods; moderate adoption within ASIC/HT research.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on hardware trojans; instances are often synthetic or modified AES designs so coverage/diversity is limited; results sensitive to testbench and toolflow choices; not large-scale which can limit statistical conclusions.
